notes.text: GitWatt 发布图文 workflow tested for AgentLimb: publish from creator posts, fill long-form developer-story article, use uploaded cover, choose category/topic/tags, publish, verify on creator/posts list.

workflows.name: 发布图文软文
workflows.description: Create and publish a GitWatt article-style post from a developer perspective, different from 项目首发.
steps: Open https://www.gitwatt.com/creator/posts and click 发布图文.
Fill title, long-form developer-story body, and description.
Upload/select cover image from project material library; verify cover preview shows 查看大图.
Choose category 智能体 for AI-agent/devtool projects.
Choose topics such as 初来乍到 and optionally 本周话题 for a first soft article.
Choose relevant tags such as AI工具, 开源工具, AI Agent, AI自动化.
Click 发布 and verify the article appears on /creator/posts with 已发布.
